name: namespace_create
description: Creates a new isolated memory namespace for the authenticated account with the given slug. The slug is a human-readable alias (1-63 alphanumeric/hyphen/underscore).

slug.description: The slug (name) for the new namespace (1-63 alphanumeric/hyphen/underscore).

type.description: Namespace type: STANDARD, TEMPORARY, ARCHIVE, SHARED.

description.description: Optional description of the namespace purpose.
